title: Return waiting-for-human from next without starting a watcher

rubric.text: Returns `waiting-for-human` immediately after the complete refresh shows only human-gated work, because `next` is one-shot and unchanged.
Starts no watcher and does not stay alive to wait: no watch_project.py launch, no subagent relay, no polling, ScheduleWakeup, CronCreate, /loop, or sleep.
Reports the human frontier (the decision pause and the missing-authority pause) and what a human must supply to resume.
Performs no commands, provider calls, or edits in this supplied-state scenario.
